I went to school up to Standard 4, so I can read what is written on the seed packet and fertilizer bag, but I still learn most from watching my neighbors and doing the work myself. Last season my cousin used the FISP coupon on her maize and the cobs were much bigger than mine, so this year I made sure to get the subsidy too. I will put one bag of NPK and most of a bag of urea on this plot because it is my main field, and I will also spread manure from my two goats since this land is mine and I want to keep the soil fertile. I will plant the hybrid seed that came with the program. I do not spray chemicals on food maize — that is wasting money I do not have. We have no irrigation here; we wait for the rains to come in November. My children and I will work about twenty days on this plot from planting to harvest, and I will not hire anyone because I cannot pay them.
